briefs.task: The owner, 14 Nov 2026, about the SEA module: "Please make sure the sea work is actually thinking about water as a whole. So puddles, rivers, water falls, streams, lakes, and more. We want something that's built cohesively." Earlier the same day: "The agent should look at that work from first principles and figure out how to design the best possible atmospheric system for the thrum game engine." SEA today plans only an open sea; inland water lives in older designs (docs/design/modules/WATER*.md, docs/design/decisions/E1-GPU-WATER.md) with no module planned. From first principles, design Thrum's water as one cohesive system covering every body of water a game needs, and settle how the modules, plan and build order carry it (renaming or splitting SEA if that is right). Treat the existing designs and Broadsides as evidence, not constraints. SEA M1 is being built in a worktree now; if your design changes what it builds, say so plainly.

The design review of WATERS at docs/evidence/WATERS/design-review.md asked for changes. Resolve its 4 Must Fix findings in the design and the plan. Its Suggestions are yours to take or leave; say which you took and why.

The design review of WATERS at docs/evidence/WATERS/design-review.md asked for changes. Resolve its 2 Must Fix findings in the design and the plan. Its Suggestions are yours to take or leave; say which you took and why.

The owner, 14 Nov 2026, overturning three WATERS assumptions: "Scenery reflections we must have, that's a main stay in high quality modern games. That's the standard we're after. Camera being able to go under water we need to support as well. Breaking waves is something we'd like to have as well." Revise the WATERS design, plan and done-when file (and SEA or other modules where it is right) so water reflects scenery that is off screen at the quality of shipped high-end games, the camera can go below the surface and see the underwater view and the surface from beneath, and waves shoal and break at a shore. Choose the methods from first principles and current practice; Broadsides is evidence, not a constraint. WATERS M1 is being built now; if your changes alter what it builds, say so plainly. Say which existing assumptions these choices replace, and which new modules or dependencies (such as a scene probe owner) they need.
